## Question

## Your Exploration Angle

Inspect loose objects and pack metadata as applicable. Explain object naming, compression/storage, tree path resolution, and how the README blob is content-addressed. Leave detailed ref and index semantics to other explorers.

### Non-Obvious Things
Anything surprising, historically motivated, or easy to get wrong. Things that look like they should work one way but work another.

### Open Questions
Anything you couldn't fully trace or understand. Be honest about gaps.

input.command:
python3 << 'PY'
import hashlib, os, zlib, binascii, pathlib

root = pathlib.Path(".git/objects")
objects = []
for p in root.rglob("*"):
    if p.is_file():
        objects.append(p)

print(f"loose object files: {len(objects)}")
for p in sorted(objects):
    data = p.read_bytes()
    # path is .git/objects/ab/cdef...
    oid = p.parent.name + p.name
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"path: {p}")
    print(f"oid from path: {oid}")
    print(f"on-disk size: {len(data)} bytes")
    print(f"zlib header: {data[:2].hex()} (cmf={data[0]:#04x} flg={data[1]:#04x})")
    # CMF/FLG: low 4 bits of CMF is CM (8 = deflate), upper 4 is CINFO (window)
    cm = data[0] & 0x0F
    cinfo = (data[0] >> 4) & 0x0F
    fcheck = data[1] & 0x1F
    fdict = (data[1] >> 5) & 0x1
    flevel = (data[1] >> 6) & 0x3
    print(f"  CM={cm} (8=deflate) CINFO={cinfo} (window=2^(cinfo+8)={1<<(cinfo+8)}) FCHECK={fcheck} FDICT={fdict} FLEVEL={flevel} (0=fastest,1=fast,2=default,3=max)")
    print(f"  header checksum ok: {((data[0] << 8) + data[1]) % 31 == 0}")
    raw = zlib.decompress(data)
    print(f"inflated size: {len(raw)} bytes")
    nul = raw.index(b"\x00")
    header = raw[:nul]
    payload = raw[nul+1:]
    typ, size_s = header.split(b" ", 1)
    print(f"object header: {header!r}")
    print(f"declared type: {typ.decode()} declared size: {size_s.decode()} actual payload: {len(payload)}")
    digest = hashlib.sha1(raw).hexdigest()
    print(f"sha1(header+payload): {digest}")
    print(f"matches path: {digest == oid}")
    print(f"payload hex:\n{binascii.hexlify(payload).decode()}")
    if typ == b"blob":
        print(f"payload text: {payload!r}")
    elif typ == b"commit":
        print("payload text:")
        print(payload.decode())
    elif typ == b"tree":
        print("tree entries:")
        i = 0
        while i < len(payload):
            sp = payload.index(b" ", i)
            mode = payload[i:sp]
            nul2 = payload.index(b"\x00", sp)
            name = payload[sp+1:nul2]
            sha = payload[nul2+1:nul2+21]
            print(f"  mode={mode.decode()} name={name.decode()!r} sha={sha.hex()} entry_bytes={nul2+21-i}")
            i = nul2 + 21
    # compression ratio
    print(f"compression ratio on-disk/inflated: {len(data)}/{len(raw)} = {len(data)/len(raw):.3f}")

print("\n=== recompute blob from working tree file ===")
content = pathlib.Path("README.md").read_bytes()
blob = b"blob " + str(len(content)).encode() + b"\x00" + content
print("canonical object bytes:", blob)
print("sha1:", hashlib.sha1(blob).hexdigest())
print("file bytes:", content)
print("len:", len(content))
